nodes.label: Hero Chart Image
nodes.description: Black and white close-up photograph of a financial trading chart displayed on a screen. Shows candlestick price bars with a moving average line overlay, grid lines in the background, and shallow depth of field creating a dramatic bokeh effect on the edges. Used as a hero/background image on the website to establish a forex/CFD trading atmosphere.
nodes.purpose: Hero background image for the NewEra365 forex broker website, conveying financial markets and trading activity

visual_content.subject: financial price chart on trading screen
visual_content.trend_insight: Price movement with volatility visible; general downward movement on right side of frame
